featured_reviews.name: Vinod Ramanathan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Haven of Care and Compassion

There are moments in life when we come face-to-face with the extraordinary commitment of others, and my family's experience with Aaji Care's Aarambh Versova is a shining example.  When dementia's shadow fell upon my father, we felt overwhelmed. Yet, this exceptional care center stepped forward as a beacon of hope.

From the first moment we entered, we were enveloped in warmth and understanding. The facility is thoughtfully designed, fostering a serene and secure environment so essential for those living with dementia. The staff, without exception, possess a unique blend of professionalism and heart. They understand that dementia care isn't simply medical, but deeply rooted in respect and personal connection. Their patience knows no bounds, and they find creative ways to engage with each resident, fostering moments of joy.

The activities and programs go beyond mere entertainment, providing both mental stimulation and a sense of purpose.  We've seen how music, gentle exercise, and reminiscence therapy can bring a spark back into my father's eyes, and for that, we are eternally grateful.

We would be remiss if we didn't extend special acknowledgment to Dr. Ruchi and her team of doctors and nursing staff. Their expertise in dementia care is matched only by their compassion. They've guided us through challenging moments, always taking the time to explain and reassure. Their dedication extends far beyond medical management, ensuring my father is treated with the dignity and respect he so richly deserves.

It's rare to find an institution that goes above and beyond what is expected. Aaji Care Aarambh exemplifies this. They are not simply providing care,  they are providing a lifeline for families like ours. The service they offer is an act of profound kindness and deserves our deepest appreciation.

featured_reviews.name: Sujata Shirsekar _ Staff - WhiteOakES
featured_reviews.review_text: Aarambh Aaji care has been a lifesaver for my family in helping me care for my mother. The caregivers have been wonderful with her. They are so caring and compassionate. Everyone in the office as well as all the administrative staff , especially Ajay Pillai, have been top notch and great in communicating with me whenever I  have had needs or concerns regarding her care. My mother transitioned here from the hospital after a hip fracture. She spent four months at Aarambh Aaji Care in Andheri  while waiting for her US visa. Ajay Pillai helped us with every step of the way in making sure my mother was safe and well taken care off until she arrived here  in the US. We are so grateful to have found this place.

featured_reviews.name: Meena Joglekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought our parents to Aarambh
about a year and half ago. Both my brother and I are based in the US with family obligations there as well. Although our father’s health is good, due to age (95 years) we felt he would not be able to cope with household duties as well as assisting our mother, who began to need help due to mobility issues (and recently passed away).
We give Aarambh high marks on all the factors that were important to us.
Ajay Pillai and his team run well organized and well-equipped Centers. He personally was extremely helpful in settling our parents down in Versova in the early days.
Dr. Ruchi Raichura has provided excellent professional care along with Nirosha and the nursing staff, especially for our mother in her last days (including making arrangements for her death certificate, funeral, etc) and for our father’s diabetes. They provide regular check-ups, dosage monitoring, support and follow-up in case of medical emergencies.
We also have really appreciated two more persons: the first is Shifa (and Neha), Aarambh psychologist on staff who engages our father in conversations on a variety of topics on a regular basis, providing invaluable emotional support, not to mention an array of activities to keep him mentally active - puzzles, artwork and music. The second is the excellent yoga instructor who comes in 3 times a week, and also a regular physical therapist. Aarambh also has well-planned outings to nearby parks, the beach and temples periodically.
Asma and Milan manage a clean, efficiently run facility, which for our parents included A/C, TV, daily cleaning and chair-lift to the upper level. The staff and attendants are very caring and well-trained. During covid, all procedures regarding vaccinations, and wearing of masks and sanitizers by visitors was observed meticulously.
Baby Singh, the cook, provides a great variety of foods in the meals there and the quality and taste are both very good, to fit the needs of very senior citizens.
Finally, it was very important to have a good communication system in place in order to stay in touch via video on a daily basis. Aarambh provides good wifi and phone access.
We are very happy to have found Aarambh, and highly recommend it.
Meena Joglekar & Uday Watwe
